**Please re-run this in the main Agent (or locally)** and paste results, or run the bundled script below once in the repo root; it runs the bundle, prints full provenance + mg0 CSV, and compares `draft_rate` to mg10:

```bash
cd "/Users/charleslevine/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/1-Documents/00- Dissertation/0-Next_Chapter/Code_and_Data/New SQL and PY Code/Cursor Workspace PDE"
python sports/scripts/pass_a_empirical_bundle.py --min-team-season-games 0 --output-root "3-Master_Plan/re_entry/HEROs_and_PASSes/population_sandbox/hero"
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

root = Path("3-Master_Plan/re_entry/HEROs_and_PASSes/population_sandbox/hero")
prov_path = root / "HERO_q16_allt_min20_mg0_11_21_provenance.json"
mg0_path = root / "PASS_A_binned_draft_rate_poolq_loo_q16_allt_min20_mg0_11_21.csv"
mg10_path = root / "PASS_A_binned_draft_rate_poolq_loo_q16_allt_min20_mg10_11_21.csv"

print("=== PROVENANCE ===")
print(prov_path.read_text())

print("=== MG0 CSV ===")
print(mg0_path.read_text())

d0, d10 = pd.read_csv(mg0_path), pd.read_csv(mg10_path)
print("=== COMPARISON ===")
print(f"n_rows mg0={len(d0)} mg10={len(d10)} diff={len(d0)-len(d10)}")
keys = [c for c in ["ventile", "bin", "pool_q", "ventile_id", "bin_id"] if c in d0.columns and c in d10.columns]
if keys:
    m = d0[keys+["draft_rate"]].merge(d10[keys+["draft_rate"]], on=keys, suffixes=("_mg0","_mg10"))
    d = (m["draft_rate_mg0"] - m["draft_rate_mg10"]).abs()
    print(f"merge keys={keys} matched={len(m)} max|Δ|={d.max():.6g} mean|Δ|={d.mean():.6g}")
    print(m.sort_values(keys).to_string(index=False))
    material = d.max() > 1e-4 or (d.mean() > 1e-5 and len(m) > 1)
    print("ventile shapes differ materially:", material)
else:
    print("columns mg0", list(d0.columns), "mg10", list(d10.columns))
PY
```
